summary: Our aim was to create a story telling site where children can learn about the rovers and robot on mars and moon. Via reading these stories middle school students can learn complicated systems and important information about these rovers suitable for their level. And with the audio option disabled kids can benefit from our website.
details:
Overview of the Project – Echoes of Exploration

Echoes of Exploration: Traces Left in Space is an educational project that turns real space missions into interesting stories for kids. The project tells about equipment left on the Moon and Mars by the perspective of astronauts, rovers and scientific instruments explaining its purpose and the discoveries made with it.

In order to make education more accessible we have also made audio versions of our stories so that kids who are blind or visually impaired and struggling readers can learn from the stories by listening to them.

With a combination of storytelling, scientific precision and audio narration our project seeks to engage every curious kid in space science.
